title: Is AI Turning Us All into the Same Person? | Sandra Matz | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】人工智慧會把我們變成同一個人嗎？ |桑德拉馬茨 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: People worry about AI for all kinds of reasons.
cues.en: People worry about AI for all kinds of reasons.
cues.zh: 人們出於各種原因擔心人工智慧。

cues.text: It's polarizing, it spreads misinformation, it's coming for our jobs.
cues.en: It's polarizing, it spreads misinformation, it's coming for our jobs.
cues.zh: 它是兩極分化的，它傳播錯誤訊息，它正在搶奪我們的工作。

cues.text: And those are all good reasons to be nervous.
cues.en: And those are all good reasons to be nervous.
cues.zh: 這些都是令人緊張的充分理由。

cues.text: But what really keeps me up at night is something else.
cues.en: But what really keeps me up at night is something else.
cues.zh: 但真正讓我徹夜難眠的是別的事情。

cues.text: Something that feels more personal and perhaps even more concerning for the human experience itself.
cues.en: Something that feels more personal and perhaps even more concerning for the human experience itself.
cues.zh: 感覺更個人化，甚至更關注人類經驗本身的東西。

cues.text: I worry that AI will make us boring.
cues.en: I worry that AI will make us boring.
cues.zh: 我擔心人工智慧會讓我們變得無聊。

cues.text: You, me, all of us.
cues.en: You, me, all of us.
cues.zh: 你，我，我們所有人。

cues.text: That's because the more we outsource our decisions to AI, the more we surrender something deeply human.
cues.en: That's because the more we outsource our decisions to AI, the more we surrender something deeply human.
cues.zh: 這是因為我們越將決策外包給人工智慧，就越會放棄人類的某些東西。

cues.text: Our capacity to explore, to take risks, to stumble into the unknown,
cues.en: Our capacity to explore, to take risks, to stumble into the unknown,
cues.zh: 我們探索、冒險、闖入未知世界的能力，

cues.text: and sometimes surprise even ourselves.
cues.en: and sometimes surprise even ourselves.
cues.zh: 有時連我們自己都感到驚訝。

cues.text: I worry that without the potential for discovery, for serendipity,
cues.en: I worry that without the potential for discovery, for serendipity,
cues.zh: 我擔心如果沒有發現的潛力、偶然的機會，

cues.text: we risk becoming more shallow and unidimensional versions of who we are
cues.en: we risk becoming more shallow and unidimensional versions of who we are
cues.zh: 我們面臨著變得更加膚淺和單一維度的風險

cues.text: and who we could be, not just as humans, as individuals, but as humanity.
cues.en: and who we could be, not just as humans, as individuals, but as humanity.
cues.zh: 以及我們能夠成為什麼樣的人，不僅是作為人類、作為個體，也是作為人類。

cues.text: Now let me make this idea a bit more concrete and take you somewhere perhaps unexpected, but also totally relatable.
cues.en: Now let me make this idea a bit more concrete and take you somewhere perhaps unexpected, but also totally relatable.
cues.zh: 現在讓我把這個想法說得更具體一些，帶你去一個也許意想不到但又完全相關的地方。

cues.text: Imagine walking into a Baskin-Robbins.
cues.en: Imagine walking into a Baskin-Robbins.
cues.zh: 想像一下走進巴斯金羅賓斯。

cues.text: What you'll see is an illustrious assortment of 31 different ice cream flavors.
cues.en: What you'll see is an illustrious assortment of 31 different ice cream flavors.
cues.zh: 您將看到 31 種不同口味的冰淇淋。

cues.text: There's chocolate chip, pistachio, almond, lemon sorbet, and many more.
cues.en: There's chocolate chip, pistachio, almond, lemon sorbet, and many more.
cues.zh: 有巧克力片、開心果、杏仁、檸檬冰淇淋等等。

cues.text: You're now facing a difficult choice.
cues.en: You're now facing a difficult choice.
cues.zh: 你現在面臨著一個艱難的選擇。

cues.text: Are you going to go with an old favorite, chocolate maybe, or are you going to take a risk on something funky and new,
cues.en: Are you going to go with an old favorite, chocolate maybe, or are you going to take a risk on something funky and new,
cues.zh: 你會選擇舊的最愛，也許是巧克力，還是會冒險嘗試一些時髦的新東西，

cues.text: like wild and reckless sherbet?
cues.en: like wild and reckless sherbet?
cues.zh: 像狂野魯莽的果子露？

cues.text: And yes, it's a real flavor.
cues.en: And yes, it's a real flavor.
cues.zh: 是的，這是真正的味道。

cues.text: The choice you're facing is a classic human dilemma scientists call the exploitation- exploration trade-off.
cues.en: The choice you're facing is a classic human dilemma scientists call the exploitation- exploration trade-off.
cues.zh: 你面臨的選擇是典型的人類困境，科學家稱之為開發-探索權衡。

cues.text: Are you going to play it safe and capitalize on what you know you like,
cues.en: Are you going to play it safe and capitalize on what you know you like,
cues.zh: 你會謹慎行事並利用你知道自己喜歡的東西嗎？

cues.text: or are you going to take a risk with the hope of finding something even better?
cues.en: or are you going to take a risk with the hope of finding something even better?
cues.zh: 或者你會冒險希望找到更好的東西嗎？

cues.text: And our lives are full of these trade offs.
cues.en: And our lives are full of these trade offs.
cues.zh: 我們的生活充滿了這些權衡。

cues.text: Stick with your favorite restaurant or try the fancy new spot on the corner.
cues.en: Stick with your favorite restaurant or try the fancy new spot on the corner.
cues.zh: 堅持選擇您最喜歡的餐廳或嘗試街角的新奇餐廳。

cues.text: Keep your usual haircut or ask for something new and edgy.
cues.en: Keep your usual haircut or ask for something new and edgy.
cues.zh: 保持你平常的髮型或要求一些新的和前衛的髮型。

cues.text: Stay in your stable job or finally try to become a pickleball champion?
cues.en: Stay in your stable job or finally try to become a pickleball champion?
cues.zh: 繼續穩定的工作還是最終嘗試成為匹克球冠軍？

cues.text: We all differ in our appetite for exploitation versus exploration.
cues.en: We all differ in our appetite for exploitation versus exploration.
cues.zh: 我們對開發和探索的興趣各不相同。

cues.text: But we're also all hardwired by evolution to strike a certain balance between the two,
cues.en: But we're also all hardwired by evolution to strike a certain balance between the two,
cues.zh: 但我們也都透過進化而在兩者之間取得一定的平衡，

cues.text: because for our ancestors on the African savanna, the trade-off was actually pretty simple.
cues.en: because for our ancestors on the African savanna, the trade-off was actually pretty simple.
cues.zh: 因為對於我們生活在非洲大草原的祖先來說，這種權衡其實非常簡單。

cues.text: Stick too closely to what's safe and you risk starvation when the grove runs dry.
cues.en: Stick too closely to what's safe and you risk starvation when the grove runs dry.
cues.zh: 過於靠近安全的地方，當樹林乾涸時，你就會面臨挨餓的風險。

cues.text: Stray too far into the unknown and you might get poisoned or eaten by lions.
cues.en: Stray too far into the unknown and you might get poisoned or eaten by lions.
cues.zh: 誤入未知領域太遠，你可能會中毒或被獅子吃掉。

cues.text: Luckily for you and me, the trade offs we face today are far less about survival.
cues.en: Luckily for you and me, the trade offs we face today are far less about survival.
cues.zh: 對你我來說幸運的是，我們今天面臨的權衡遠遠不是為了生存。

cues.text: But our choices are still governed by this instinct to balance caution with curiosity.
cues.en: But our choices are still governed by this instinct to balance caution with curiosity.
cues.zh: 但我們的選擇仍然受這種平衡謹慎與好奇的本能所支配。

cues.text: If all you ever did in life was play it safe and exploit,
cues.en: If all you ever did in life was play it safe and exploit,
cues.zh: 如果你一生中所做的一切就是安全行事和利用，

cues.text: you'd never get disappointed, but you'd also never get a chance to advance and grow.
cues.en: you'd never get disappointed, but you'd also never get a chance to advance and grow.
cues.zh: 你永遠不會失望，但你也永遠沒有機會進步和成長。

cues.text: If all you did instead was discover and explore,
cues.en: If all you did instead was discover and explore,
cues.zh: 如果你所做的只是發現和探索，

cues.text: you'd collect endless experiences, but you'd also never get a chance to capitalize on your learnings.
cues.en: you'd collect endless experiences, but you'd also never get a chance to capitalize on your learnings.
cues.zh: 你會收集無盡的經驗，但你也永遠沒有機會利用你所學到的知識。

cues.text: So it's really this balance between exploitation and exploration
cues.en: So it's really this balance between exploitation and exploration
cues.zh: 所以這其實是利用和探索之間的平衡

cues.text: that fuels our growth, not just as a species, but also as individuals.
cues.en: that fuels our growth, not just as a species, but also as individuals.
cues.zh: 這不僅促進了我們作為一個物種的成長，也促進了我們作為個人的成長。

cues.text: But that's exactly where AI throws a wrench into the works,
cues.en: But that's exactly where AI throws a wrench into the works,
cues.zh: 但這正是人工智慧阻礙工作的地方，

cues.text: because AI hates risk.
cues.en: because AI hates risk.
cues.zh: 因為人工智慧討厭風險。

cues.text: And that's not because of its algorithmic DNA.
cues.en: And that's not because of its algorithmic DNA.
cues.zh: 這並不是因為它的演演算法 DNA。

cues.text: It's because the systems we rely on to navigate our world, from Spotify to Netflix to ChatGPT,
cues.en: It's because the systems we rely on to navigate our world, from Spotify to Netflix to ChatGPT,
cues.zh: 這是因為我們賴以導航的系統，從 Spotify 到 Netflix 再到 ChatGPT，

cues.text: are overwhelmingly trained to optimize for exploitation.
cues.en: are overwhelmingly trained to optimize for exploitation.
cues.zh: 絕大多數人都接受過最佳化剝削訓練。

cues.text: Or more specifically, for short-term engagement and satisfaction.
cues.en: Or more specifically, for short-term engagement and satisfaction.
cues.zh: 或者更具體地說，是為了短期參與和滿意度。

cues.text: Did you click the link, watch the video, like the song?
cues.en: Did you click the link, watch the video, like the song?
cues.zh: 您點選連結、觀看影片、喜歡這首歌嗎？

cues.text: If yes, AI gets a clap on the shoulder.
cues.en: If yes, AI gets a clap on the shoulder.
cues.zh: 如果是的話，人工智慧就會拍拍肩膀。

cues.text: If no, it gets a slap on the hand.
cues.en: If no, it gets a slap on the hand.
cues.zh: 如果沒有，就會被打一巴掌。

cues.text: Risk, discovery and exploration are simply not part of their programming.
cues.en: Risk, discovery and exploration are simply not part of their programming.
cues.zh: 風險、發現和探索根本不是他們計劃的一部分。

cues.text: Think back to Baskin-Robbins.
cues.en: Think back to Baskin-Robbins.
cues.zh: 回想一下巴斯金羅賓斯。

cues.text: If 60 percent of people preferred the flavor pralines and cream,
cues.en: If 60 percent of people preferred the flavor pralines and cream,
cues.zh: 如果 60% 的人喜歡果仁糖和奶油的味道，

cues.text: then that's what the AI is going to recommend.
cues.en: then that's what the AI is going to recommend.
cues.zh: 那麼這就是人工智慧會推薦的內容。

cues.text: It's not that AI lacks imagination.
cues.en: It's not that AI lacks imagination.
cues.zh: 並不是說人工智慧缺乏想像力。

cues.text: It lacks incentive.
cues.en: It lacks incentive.
cues.zh: 它缺乏激勵。

cues.text: Safe bets protect against disappointment, which in turn reduces customer churn.
cues.en: Safe bets protect against disappointment, which in turn reduces customer churn.
cues.zh: 安全的投注可以防止失望，從而減少客戶流失。

cues.text: So instead of taking this risky gamble that helps you explore, companies tend to err on the side of exploitation
cues.en: So instead of taking this risky gamble that helps you explore, companies tend to err on the side of exploitation
cues.zh: 因此，公司往往會犯下剝削的錯誤，而不是進行這種幫助你探索的冒險賭博

cues.text: when training their AI systems.
cues.en: when training their AI systems.
cues.zh: 在訓練他們的人工智慧系統時。

cues.text: And to be clear, there's nothing inherently wrong with that.
cues.en: And to be clear, there's nothing inherently wrong with that.
cues.zh: 需要明確的是，這本身並沒有什麼問題。

cues.text: I've spent the last 15 years as a computational social scientist
cues.en: I've spent the last 15 years as a computational social scientist
cues.zh: 過去 15 年我一直擔任計算社會科學家

cues.text: working at the intersection of psychology, computer science, and business.
cues.en: working at the intersection of psychology, computer science, and business.
cues.zh: 從事心理學、電腦科學和商業交叉領域的工作。

cues.text: And I know that rewarding AI in that way can be extremely valuable.
cues.en: And I know that rewarding AI in that way can be extremely valuable.
cues.zh: 我知道以這種方式獎勵人工智慧是非常有價值的。

cues.text: Algorithms, in a way, only become so good at figuring out what you might enjoy
cues.en: Algorithms, in a way, only become so good at figuring out what you might enjoy
cues.zh: 在某種程度上，演演算法只會變得非常擅長弄清楚你可能喜歡什麼

cues.text: or currently be looking for because they focus on exploitation.
cues.en: or currently be looking for because they focus on exploitation.
cues.zh: 或目前正在尋找，因為他們專注於剝削。

cues.text: And that's not just good for business.
cues.en: And that's not just good for business.
cues.zh: 這不僅有利於商業。

cues.text: It's also good and sometimes even necessary for us as consumers.
cues.en: It's also good and sometimes even necessary for us as consumers.
cues.zh: 對我們身為消費者來說，這也是好事，有時甚至是必要的。

cues.text: For me, the mere thought of having to choose between 31 different ice cream flavors makes me dizzy.
cues.en: For me, the mere thought of having to choose between 31 different ice cream flavors makes me dizzy.
cues.zh: 對我來說，一想到必須在 31 種不同口味的冰淇淋中進行選擇就讓我頭暈。

cues.text: And yet, most of the choices that we face day-to-day are far more complex than that.
cues.en: And yet, most of the choices that we face day-to-day are far more complex than that.
cues.zh: 然而，我們每天面臨的大多數選擇都比這複雜得多。

cues.text: Netflix, for example, has over 5,500 movies to choose from.
cues.en: Netflix, for example, has over 5,500 movies to choose from.
cues.zh: 例如，Netflix 有超過 5,500 部電影可供選擇。

cues.text: Spotify, over 100 million songs.
cues.en: Spotify, over 100 million songs.
cues.zh: Spotify，超過 1 億首歌曲。

cues.text: So the truth is that without a little help from our exploitation-loving AI friends,
cues.en: So the truth is that without a little help from our exploitation-loving AI friends,
cues.zh: 所以事實是，如果沒有我們熱愛剝削的人工智慧朋友的一點幫助，

cues.text: we simply don't stand a chance at navigating modern life.
cues.en: we simply don't stand a chance at navigating modern life.
cues.zh: 我們根本沒有機會駕馭現代生活。

cues.text: But I've also become increasingly concerned that this upside comes at a somewhat existential cost.
cues.en: But I've also become increasingly concerned that this upside comes at a somewhat existential cost.
cues.zh: 但我也越來越擔心這種好處會帶來某種生存成本。

cues.text: And to give you a first flavor of what I mean by that, let's go back to Baskin-Robbins.
cues.en: And to give you a first flavor of what I mean by that, let's go back to Baskin-Robbins.
cues.zh: 為了讓您初步瞭解我的意思，讓我們回到巴斯金-羅賓斯。

cues.text: Before coming here, I ran a simple experiment.
cues.en: Before coming here, I ran a simple experiment.
cues.zh: 在來這裡之前，我做了一個簡單的實驗。

cues.text: I asked ChatGPT to recommend one of their ice cream flavors.
cues.en: I asked ChatGPT to recommend one of their ice cream flavors.
cues.zh: 我請 ChatGPT 推薦他們的一種冰淇淋口味。

cues.text: I did that 100 times, each round pretending to be a new customer.
cues.en: I did that 100 times, each round pretending to be a new customer.
cues.zh: 我這樣做了 100 次，每一輪都假裝自己是新顧客。

cues.text: Ninety-six times it recommended one of their two most popular flavors --
cues.en: Ninety-six times it recommended one of their two most popular flavors --
cues.zh: 它九十六次推薦了他們最受歡迎的兩種口味之一——

cues.text: Pralines and Cream and Mint Chocolate Chip -- which I realize, and I’m sure you’d agree,
cues.en: Pralines and Cream and Mint Chocolate Chip -- which I realize, and I’m sure you’d agree,
cues.zh: 果仁糖、奶油和薄荷巧克力片——我知道，我相信你也會同意，

cues.text: is not exactly a very diverse set of choices.
cues.en: is not exactly a very diverse set of choices.
cues.zh: 並不完全是一組非常多樣化的選擇。

cues.text: And it could mean that we soon find ourselves in a world where Baskin-Robbins offers only those two flavors.
cues.en: And it could mean that we soon find ourselves in a world where Baskin-Robbins offers only those two flavors.
cues.zh: 這可能意味著我們很快就會發現巴斯金羅賓斯只提供這兩種口味。

cues.text: If no one ever picks the other 29, why bother offering them in the first place?
cues.en: If no one ever picks the other 29, why bother offering them in the first place?
cues.zh: 如果沒有人選擇其他 29 個，為什麼還要費心提供它們呢？

cues.text: Now this might sound trivial and not really existential at all,
cues.en: Now this might sound trivial and not really existential at all,
cues.zh: 現在這聽起來可能微不足道，而且根本不存在，

cues.text: but that's only until you realize that this flattening of the human experience
cues.en: but that's only until you realize that this flattening of the human experience
cues.zh: 但直到你意識到人類經驗的扁平化

cues.text: happens across every aspect of life.
cues.en: happens across every aspect of life.
cues.zh: 發生在生活的各個方面。

cues.text: In studies with my collaborators and students, we've shown that when people use AI for guidance,
cues.en: In studies with my collaborators and students, we've shown that when people use AI for guidance,
cues.zh: 在與我的合作者和學生的研究中，我們表明，當人們使用人工智慧進行指導時，

cues.text: their preferences become more normative and less diverse, their creative output becomes less unique,
cues.en: their preferences become more normative and less diverse, their creative output becomes less unique,
cues.zh: 他們的偏好變得更加規範和多樣化，他們的創意輸出變得不那麼獨特，

cues.text: and their choice of the most important scientists, athletes and historical figures becomes the same as everyone else's.
cues.en: and their choice of the most important scientists, athletes and historical figures becomes the same as everyone else's.
cues.zh: 他們對最重要的科學家、運動員和歷史人物的選擇也變得和其他人一樣。

cues.text: So in a nutshell, AI turns this infinite diversity of human opinions, beliefs
cues.en: So in a nutshell, AI turns this infinite diversity of human opinions, beliefs
cues.zh: 簡言之，人工智慧改變了人類觀點、信仰的無限多樣性

cues.text: and preferences into statistically safe sameness.
cues.en: and preferences into statistically safe sameness.
cues.zh: 和偏好變成統計上安全的相同性。

cues.text: And that's only part of the problem, because even when AI learns your quirks --
cues.en: And that's only part of the problem, because even when AI learns your quirks --
cues.zh: 這只是問題的一部分，因為即使人工智慧瞭解了你的怪癖——

cues.text: say, it figures out that you like nutty coconut better than pralines and cream --
cues.en: say, it figures out that you like nutty coconut better than pralines and cream --
cues.zh: 比如說，它發現你比果仁糖和奶油更喜歡堅果椰子——

cues.text: it will still play it safe within your preferences.
cues.en: it will still play it safe within your preferences.
cues.zh: 它仍然會在您的偏好範圍內安全執行。

cues.text: Meaning it is going to optimize for what you are most likely to like.
cues.en: Meaning it is going to optimize for what you are most likely to like.
cues.zh: 這意味著它將針對您最可能喜歡的內容進行最佳化。

cues.text: I went back to ChatGPT for a second experiment and this time told it about my personal ice cream preferences.
cues.en: I went back to ChatGPT for a second experiment and this time told it about my personal ice cream preferences.
cues.zh: 我回到 ChatGPT 進行第二次實驗，這次告訴它我個人的冰淇淋偏好。

cues.text: I said that during my last 100 visits, I picked nutty coconut 70 percent of the time.
cues.en: I said that during my last 100 visits, I picked nutty coconut 70 percent of the time.
cues.zh: 我說過，在我過去 100 次訪問中，70% 的時間我都選擇了堅果椰子。

cues.text: The remaining 30 percent, I split evenly among three of my other favorites.
cues.en: The remaining 30 percent, I split evenly among three of my other favorites.
cues.zh: 剩下的 30%，我平分給我最喜歡的其他三個。

cues.text: I then asked it to make the next 100 choices on my behalf.
cues.en: I then asked it to make the next 100 choices on my behalf.
cues.zh: 然後我要求它代表我做出接下來的 100 個選擇。

cues.text: And guess what it did?
cues.en: And guess what it did?
cues.zh: 猜猜它做了什麼？

cues.text: It picked nutty coconut every single time.
cues.en: It picked nutty coconut every single time.
cues.zh: 它每次都會採摘堅果椰子。

cues.text: Gone are my adventures into occasional chocolate fudge, cookie dough or mango.
cues.en: Gone are my adventures into occasional chocolate fudge, cookie dough or mango.
cues.zh: 我偶爾吃巧克力軟糖、餅乾麵團或芒果的冒險已經一去不復返了。

cues.text: All I am at that point is literally a nutty coconut.
cues.en: All I am at that point is literally a nutty coconut.
cues.zh: 那時我只是一個堅果椰子。

cues.text: But forget about ice cream.
cues.en: But forget about ice cream.
cues.zh: 但忘記冰淇淋吧。

cues.text: My students and I have repeatedly shown the same patterns when studying people's actual preferences.
cues.en: My students and I have repeatedly shown the same patterns when studying people's actual preferences.
cues.zh: 我和我的學生在研究人們的實際偏好時反覆表現出相同的模式。

cues.text: AI narrows your taste, it flattens your personality,
cues.en: AI narrows your taste, it flattens your personality,
cues.zh: 人工智慧縮小了你的品味，它削弱了你的個性，

cues.text: and it scrubs away the edges that make you interesting and keep you dynamic.
cues.en: and it scrubs away the edges that make you interesting and keep you dynamic.
cues.zh: 它消除了讓你變得有趣並讓你保持活力的邊緣。

cues.text: And the insidious part of all of this is that the impact of AI on human complexity is subtle.
cues.en: And the insidious part of all of this is that the impact of AI on human complexity is subtle.
cues.zh: 而這一切的陰險之處在於，人工智慧對人類複雜性的影響是微妙的。

cues.text: You won't notice it happening overnight.
cues.en: You won't notice it happening overnight.
cues.zh: 你不會注意到它在一夜之間發生。

cues.text: Rather, it's a death by a thousand algorithmic recommendations.
cues.en: Rather, it's a death by a thousand algorithmic recommendations.
cues.zh: 相反，這是一千個演演算法建議的死亡。

cues.text: It's one slightly safer movie, one slightly more popular book, one slightly more mainstream vacation at a time.
cues.en: It's one slightly safer movie, one slightly more popular book, one slightly more mainstream vacation at a time.
cues.zh: 這是一部稍微更安全的電影，一本更受歡迎的書，一個更主流的假期。

cues.text: With every decision you outsource to AI, you become more narrow.
cues.en: With every decision you outsource to AI, you become more narrow.
cues.zh: 當你將每一個決策外包給人工智慧時，你就會變得更加狹隘。

cues.text: Then AI learns from that shallower version of you and narrows its recommendations even more.
cues.en: Then AI learns from that shallower version of you and narrows its recommendations even more.
cues.zh: 然後人工智慧會向你的淺薄版本學習，並進一步縮小其建議範圍。

cues.text: The New York Times reporter Kashmir Hill captured this dilemma perfectly
cues.en: The New York Times reporter Kashmir Hill captured this dilemma perfectly
cues.zh: 《紐約時報》記者克什米爾·希爾完美捕捉到了這一困境

cues.text: in one of her articles.
cues.en: in one of her articles.
cues.zh: 在她的一篇文章中。

cues.text: After outsourcing her decisions to AI for a week, she complained about its hidden agenda to turn her into a "basic bitch."
cues.en: After outsourcing her decisions to AI for a week, she complained about its hidden agenda to turn her into a "basic bitch."
cues.zh: 在將自己的決定外包給人工智慧一週後，她抱怨人工智慧隱藏的議程將她變成了一個「基本的婊子」。

cues.text: And the funny part is, it's the word basic here that's the biggest insult.
cues.en: And the funny part is, it's the word basic here that's the biggest insult.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，這裡的「基本」這個字才是最大的侮辱。

cues.text: Because being basic means being unoriginal, unexceptional and uninteresting.
cues.en: Because being basic means being unoriginal, unexceptional and uninteresting.
cues.zh: 因為基礎意味著非原創、平庸和無趣。

cues.text: It's offensive, not because it suggests failure, but because it implies mediocrity, an absence of complexity.
cues.en: It's offensive, not because it suggests failure, but because it implies mediocrity, an absence of complexity.
cues.zh: 它令人反感，不是因為它意味著失敗，而是因為它意味著平庸、缺乏複雜性。

cues.text: And who really wants it for themselves?
cues.en: And who really wants it for themselves?
cues.zh: 誰真正想要自己擁有它？

cues.text: Nobody.
cues.en: Nobody.
cues.zh: 沒有人。

cues.text: We all like the feeling of being unique, of being special, of being someone who doesn't easily fit into a box.
cues.en: We all like the feeling of being unique, of being special, of being someone who doesn't easily fit into a box.
cues.zh: 我們都喜歡獨特的感覺，特別的感覺，喜歡成為一個不容易融入盒子的人。

cues.text: I, for one, don't want to become exactly like everybody else.
cues.en: I, for one, don't want to become exactly like everybody else.
cues.zh: 就我而言，我不想變得和其他人一樣。

cues.text: And I also don't want to become a singular version of myself.
cues.en: And I also don't want to become a singular version of myself.
cues.zh: 我也不想成為一個單一的自己。

cues.text: So what can we do to course-correct and avoid destination basic bitch?
cues.en: So what can we do to course-correct and avoid destination basic bitch?
cues.zh: 那麼我們能做些什麼來糾正方向並避免目的地的基本婊子呢？

cues.text: We can’t hit the reset button on AI, and we shouldn’t.
cues.en: We can’t hit the reset button on AI, and we shouldn’t.
cues.zh: 我們不能也不應該按下人工智慧的重置按鈕。

cues.text: As I said before, these tools are incredibly valuable for navigating modern life,
cues.en: As I said before, these tools are incredibly valuable for navigating modern life,
cues.zh: 正如我之前所說，這些工具對於駕馭現代生活非常有價值，

cues.text: and they make us better off in many ways.
cues.en: and they make us better off in many ways.
cues.zh: 他們在很多方面都讓我們過得更好。

cues.text: But we need to reclaim our ability to take risks and discover.
cues.en: But we need to reclaim our ability to take risks and discover.
cues.zh: 但我們需要重新找回承擔風險和發現的能力。

cues.text: We need to find a way to rebalance exploitation and exploration.
cues.en: We need to find a way to rebalance exploitation and exploration.
cues.zh: 我們需要找到一種重新平衡開發和探索的方法。

cues.text: And ironically, AI could actually help us accomplish just that,
cues.en: And ironically, AI could actually help us accomplish just that,
cues.zh: 諷刺的是，人工智慧實際上可以幫助我們實現這一目標，

cues.text: but only if we ask the right questions and reward it for the right actions.
cues.en: but only if we ask the right questions and reward it for the right actions.
cues.zh: 但前提是我們提出正確的問題並獎勵其正確的行動。

cues.text: So instead of asking it to help us find something we like, we could start asking it to help us find something new,
cues.en: So instead of asking it to help us find something we like, we could start asking it to help us find something new,
cues.zh: 因此，我們可以開始要求它幫助我們找到新的東西，而不是要求它幫助我們找到我們喜歡的東西，

cues.text: something we're likely to love, even though we've never tried it before.
cues.en: something we're likely to love, even though we've never tried it before.
cues.zh: 我們可能會喜歡的東西，即使我們以前從未嘗試過。

cues.text: And by that, I don't necessarily mean you typing that question into ChatGPT yourself,
cues.en: And by that, I don't necessarily mean you typing that question into ChatGPT yourself,
cues.zh: 我這麼說並不一定意味著您自己在 ChatGPT 中輸入該問題，

cues.text: although you should certainly try.
cues.en: although you should certainly try.
cues.zh: 儘管你當然應該嘗試。

cues.text: What I mean is getting companies to harness AI’s superpower,
cues.en: What I mean is getting companies to harness AI’s superpower,
cues.zh: 我的意思是讓公司利用人工智慧的超能力，

cues.text: its ability to detect patterns in vast amounts of human data
cues.en: its ability to detect patterns in vast amounts of human data
cues.zh: 它能夠檢測大量人類資料中的模式

cues.text: for exploration purposes.
cues.en: for exploration purposes.
cues.zh: 出於探索目的。

cues.text: Because AI has seen the entire universe of preferences -- it knows not only what you currently like,
cues.en: Because AI has seen the entire universe of preferences -- it knows not only what you currently like,
cues.zh: 因為人工智慧已經瞭解了整個偏好領域——它不僅知道你目前喜歡什麼，

cues.text: but also what lies just beyond the boundaries of your typical preferences --
cues.en: but also what lies just beyond the boundaries of your typical preferences --
cues.zh: 還有那些超出你典型偏好範圍的東西——

cues.text: which means that it can help you explore smartly to take curated risks when you want to.
cues.en: which means that it can help you explore smartly to take curated risks when you want to.
cues.zh: 這意味著它可以幫助您在需要時明智地探索並承擔策劃的風險。

cues.text: Now here's what this could look like.
cues.en: Now here's what this could look like.
cues.zh: 現在這就是它的樣子。

cues.text: Imagine a dial on your Netflix account or your Google search bar
cues.en: Imagine a dial on your Netflix account or your Google search bar
cues.zh: 想像您的 Netflix 帳戶或 Google 搜尋欄上的撥號盤

cues.text: that lets you decide how far from your typical preferences
cues.en: that lets you decide how far from your typical preferences
cues.zh: 讓您決定與您的典型偏好相差多遠

cues.text: you want to stray at any given point in time.
cues.en: you want to stray at any given point in time.
cues.zh: 你想在任何給定的時間點迷失。

cues.text: On a regular day, you probably keep the dial close to the "spot on" setting
cues.en: On a regular day, you probably keep the dial close to the "spot on" setting
cues.zh: 在平常的日子裡，您可能會將錶盤保持在「準確」設定附近

cues.text: because you want to get the most relevant hits right away.
cues.en: because you want to get the most relevant hits right away.
cues.zh: 因為您想立即獲得最相關的點選。

cues.text: But then on other days, you might feel adventurous enough to push it a little closer to the "me with a twist" setting
cues.en: But then on other days, you might feel adventurous enough to push it a little closer to the "me with a twist" setting
cues.zh: 但在其他日子裡，你可能會覺得有足夠的冒險精神，將其推向“有點扭曲的我”設定

cues.text: and ask for content that's a little outside of your comfort zone,
cues.en: and ask for content that's a little outside of your comfort zone,
cues.zh: 並要求提供稍微超出您舒適區的內容，

cues.text: but still relevant.
cues.en: but still relevant.
cues.zh: 但仍然相關。

cues.text: And then on other days, for those rare moments when you feel like you're really ready
cues.en: And then on other days, for those rare moments when you feel like you're really ready
cues.zh: 然後在其他日子裡，在那些難得的時刻，當你覺得自己真的準備好了時

cues.text: to take on the world, you might push the dial all the way to the "wildcard" setting
cues.en: to take on the world, you might push the dial all the way to the "wildcard" setting
cues.zh: 要征服世界，您可以將旋鈕一直推到“萬用字元”設定

cues.text: and ask it to help you discover something entirely new.
cues.en: and ask it to help you discover something entirely new.
cues.zh: 並要求它幫助您發現全新的東西。

cues.text: I, for one, would love to have such a dial.
cues.en: I, for one, would love to have such a dial.
cues.zh: 就我個人而言，我很想擁有這樣一個錶盤。

cues.text: It doesn't force me to leave my comfort zone.
cues.en: It doesn't force me to leave my comfort zone.
cues.zh: 它不會強迫我離開我的舒適圈。

cues.text: I can always leave it on the "spot on" setting and benefit from the convenience that comes with it.
cues.en: I can always leave it on the "spot on" setting and benefit from the convenience that comes with it.
cues.zh: 我可以隨時將其置於“現場”設定，並受益於它帶來的便利。

cues.text: But it gives me the choice and the agency to break out of my little bubble whenever I want to,
cues.en: But it gives me the choice and the agency to break out of my little bubble whenever I want to,
cues.zh: 但它給了我選擇和力量，讓我可以隨時打破我的小泡沫，

cues.text: or I feel like I have to.
cues.en: or I feel like I have to.
cues.zh: 或者我覺得我必須這麼做。

cues.text: But here's the catch.
cues.en: But here's the catch.
cues.zh: 但這就是問題所在。

cues.text: For AI to toggle its superpower between exploitation and exploration,
cues.en: For AI to toggle its superpower between exploitation and exploration,
cues.zh: 對於人工智慧來說，要在利用和探索之間切換其超能力，

cues.text: we need to incentivize it to do so.
cues.en: we need to incentivize it to do so.
cues.zh: 我們需要激勵它這樣做。

cues.text: Merely asking it to be more creative or help you become more adventurous
cues.en: Merely asking it to be more creative or help you become more adventurous
cues.zh: 只要要求它更有創意或幫助你變得更具冒險精神

cues.text: isn't going to do the trick.
cues.en: isn't going to do the trick.
cues.zh: 不會成功的。

cues.text: In most cases, it will still default to the tried-and-tested output
cues.en: In most cases, it will still default to the tried-and-tested output
cues.zh: 在大多數情況下，它仍然預設為經過嘗試和測試的輸出

cues.text: because it craves that clap on the shoulder.
cues.en: because it craves that clap on the shoulder.
cues.zh: 因為它渴望拍拍肩膀。

cues.text: So instead of punishing AI every time it takes a swing and misses,
cues.en: So instead of punishing AI every time it takes a swing and misses,
cues.zh: 因此，與其在每次揮桿失敗時懲罰人工智慧，

cues.text: we need to start rewarding it for taking smart swings,
cues.en: we need to start rewarding it for taking smart swings,
cues.zh: 我們需要開始獎勵它採取明智的行動，

cues.text: for making bets that are a little bold, a little unusual, perhaps,
cues.en: for making bets that are a little bold, a little unusual, perhaps,
cues.zh: 做出有點大膽、有點不尋常的賭注，也許，

cues.text: but still grounded in what it knows about us.
cues.en: but still grounded in what it knows about us.
cues.zh: 但仍基於它對我們的瞭解。

cues.text: AI doesn't have to throw darts in the dark.
cues.en: AI doesn't have to throw darts in the dark.
cues.zh: 人工智慧不必在黑暗中扔飛鏢。

cues.text: It can take informed risks.
cues.en: It can take informed risks.
cues.zh: 它可以承擔知情的風險。

cues.text: It can help us optimize our exploration.
cues.en: It can help us optimize our exploration.
cues.zh: 它可以幫助我們最佳化我們的探索。

cues.text: And when it does, we should treat it as a success, not a failure.
cues.en: And when it does, we should treat it as a success, not a failure.
cues.zh: 當它發生時，我們應該將其視為成功，而不是失敗。

cues.text: Now this isn’t about desserts or playlists.
cues.en: Now this isn’t about desserts or playlists.
cues.zh: 現在這與甜點或播放清單無關。

cues.text: This is about preserving what makes us uniquely, messily and gloriously human.
cues.en: This is about preserving what makes us uniquely, messily and gloriously human.
cues.zh: 這是為了保護我們獨特、混亂和光榮的人類特質。

cues.text: It’s your random passion for E.T. memorabilia, your weird detour into geocaching,
cues.en: It’s your random passion for E.T. memorabilia, your weird detour into geocaching,
cues.zh: 這是你對《E.T.》的隨意熱情。紀念品，你奇怪的尋寶之旅，

cues.text: or your stubborn preference for a stick-shift car.
cues.en: or your stubborn preference for a stick-shift car.
cues.zh: 或您對手排車的頑固偏好。

cues.text: It’s about all the contradictions that AI can’t quite explain
cues.en: It’s about all the contradictions that AI can’t quite explain
cues.zh: 這是關於人工智慧無法完全解釋的所有矛盾

cues.text: and the beauty of us being just a little weird once in a while.
cues.en: and the beauty of us being just a little weird once in a while.
cues.zh: 我們的美麗只是偶爾有點奇怪。

cues.text: And if we believe that human complexity is worth preserving, then the time to act is now.
cues.en: And if we believe that human complexity is worth preserving, then the time to act is now.
cues.zh: 如果我們相信人類的複雜性值得保留，現在就是採取行動的時候了。

cues.text: Because we're at this inflection point where AI is no longer just recommending
cues.en: Because we're at this inflection point where AI is no longer just recommending
cues.zh: 因為我們正處於人工智慧不再只是推薦的轉折點

cues.text: but starting to act on our behalf.
cues.en: but starting to act on our behalf.
cues.zh: 但開始代表我們行事。

cues.text: It's choosing, not suggesting.
cues.en: It's choosing, not suggesting.
cues.zh: 這是選擇，而不是建議。

cues.text: And that's where the stakes become really existential.
cues.en: And that's where the stakes become really existential.
cues.zh: 這就是賭注變得真正存在的地方。

cues.text: So next time AI offers you pralines and cream, maybe say no
cues.en: So next time AI offers you pralines and cream, maybe say no
cues.zh: 所以下次人工智慧給你果仁糖和奶油時，也許會說不

cues.text: and ask it to help you go wild and reckless instead.
cues.en: and ask it to help you go wild and reckless instead.
cues.zh: 並請求它幫助你變得狂野和魯莽。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。
